name: A new card that would break a milestone

blocks.text: Moving groceries to ACE would drop Millennia below ₹1 lakh a quarter and lose its ₹1,000 voucher four times a year.

msgs.what: 1.5% on ACE beats Millennia's 1% chunk by chunk…
…so Millennia misses its quarterly voucher milestone: −₹4,000 a year.
A second start routes exactly as the held cards did; hill-climbing then moves only lines that pay off.
Adding a card can never score below your current stack minus its fee. Checked by test_adding_a_card_never_costs_more_than_its_fee.
